title: EvaluationExampleSchema
description: Standardized schema for technical interview evaluation training and validation examples.

example_id.description: Unique identifier for the training/evaluation example.

question_id.description: Identifier referencing the source technical question.

question.description: The exact interview question text presented to the candidate.

evaluated_skill.description: Primary technical skill or competency being evaluated (e.g. Node.js, PostgreSQL, Distributed Systems).

difficulty.description: Target difficulty level of the question on a standard 1-4 scale.

candidate_transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of the candidate response (may be empty for silence/no-answer).

expected_concepts.description: Key technical concepts, architectural primitives, or keywords expected in a complete answer.

status.description: Evaluation outcome status indicating whether candidate provided an answer or no-answer.

technical_depth.description: Score for Technical Depth (1.0-5.0). Null if status is NO_ANSWER.

problem_solving.description: Score for Problem Solving (1.0-5.0). Null if status is NO_ANSWER.

practical_experience.description: Score for Practical Experience (1.0-5.0). Null if status is NO_ANSWER.

communication_clarity.description: Score for Communication Clarity (1.0-5.0). Null if status is NO_ANSWER.

overall_score.description: Overall weighted rubric score: 0.35*TD + 0.25*PS + 0.20*PE + 0.20*CC. Null if status is NO_ANSWER.

direct_quotes.description: Verbatim quote strings extracted directly from candidate_transcript. Must be empty if NO_ANSWER.

key_strengths.description: Bullet points highlighting specific demonstrated competencies and correct concepts.

gaps_identified.description: Bullet points highlighting technical omissions, misconceptions, or unaddressed aspects.

scoring_rationale.description: Concise expert narrative explaining and justifying the awarded scores.

recommended_follow_up.description: Optional recommended follow-up topic or probing question to test depth or resolve gaps.

recommended_difficulty.description: Recommended difficulty level for the subsequent question (1-4).
